method: Crosschecked legacy target location against all Purdue GIS Provenance plan-feature centroids, then required independent explicit county-plan label plus current orthophoto overlay before assigning the individual building.
crosswalk_conclusion: FID 506 is the nearest mapped apartment building to the inherited .005 object center by 33.27 m over the next-nearest FID 501 (Building E). It is explicitly labeled BLDG F / 143 on county construction-plan sheet C1.4, between BLDG E / 144 and BLDG G / 142. A no-warp overlay of the transformed FID 506 ring aligns closely with the central Building F roof outline in Indiana 2025 orthophoto. These independent sources support the stable .005-to-Building F identity; the previous model's broad bounds are only a rough center and not wall geometry.
remaining_limitations: Purdue GIS FID 506 remains tagged BLDG Building Pre-planning; the available County packet is an approved detailed construction-plan / stormwater sheet, not an as-built survey.
The orthophoto roof/eave boundary is not identical to a surveyed exterior wall line.
